en: The river's too high for the ferry, and I owe the toll-keeper more than I can pay.
note: Spoken by Ferryman Oda, tired and embarrassed.

en: Bring me wolf pelts and I'll clear my debt with the tanner.
note: Ferryman Oda. Tanner is a job.

en: Mind the toll-keeper. He counts every coin twice.
note: Bark by a villager near the bridge. Light joke.

en: Collect wolf pelts in the Greywood.
note: Objective line in the tracker. Greywood is a forest; translate.

en: That's the last of it. The river can do what it likes now.
note: Ferryman Oda, relieved. 'It' is the debt.

en: Thick grey fur. The tanner pays well for it, when he pays at all.
note: Item description. Dry humor about the tanner.
